sloka: द्वादश एते महावीर्या बल अध्यक्षाः ।स सैनिकाःरमम् एव अभ्यधावंत विसृजंतः शरोत्तमान् ॥३-२६-२८॥
transliteration: dvādaśa ete mahāvīryā bala adhyakṣāḥ ।sa sainikāḥramam eva abhyadhāvaṁta visṛjaṁtaḥ śarottamān ॥3-26-28॥

translations.english: Having spoken thus, angry Khara ran towards Rama. Syenagami, Pruthugriva, Yajnasatru, Vihanga, Durjaya, Karaveeraksha, Parusha, Kalakarmuka, Meghamali, Mahamali, Sarpasya, Rudhirasanaall these twelve valiant army chiefs along with their forces rushed towards Rama, releasing the sharpest arrows at him.
